limitations: This schema produces skill configuration values, not a playable skill initialization packet.
ClassNetCache property indices and native struct member offsets are not RepLayout handles.
Skill IDs are configuration references, not ability instance IDs or NetGUIDs.
Additional skill lists are retained as source evidence, without granting them.
A constructor default of 100 does not determine authoritative MaxHealth or Shield values.
Empty default-component updates do not initialize skills, attributes or ability instances.
